title.narrative: Enhancing adoption of Mexico’s Sustainable Taxonomy and ESG regulation

description.narrative: Active

E1: The project’s overall objective is to strengthen Mexico’s sustainable finance ecosystem by integrating the Sustainable Taxonomy into public finance, advancing ESG regulations, and supporting policy development and monitoring—ultimately enabling the mobilization of public and private capital toward climate and social goals aligned with Mexico’s NDCs and SDGs. E2: To strengthen Mexico’s sustainable finance ecosystem by supporting the adoption and implementation of the Sustainable Taxonomy, ESG regulations, and sustainable finance policies, enabling public and private financial actors to align capital flows with climate and sustainable development goals and accelerate the country’s progress toward its NDC and SDG commitments.

E1: This project supports Mexico’s NDCs and SDGs by advancing sustainable finance in three areas: integrating the Sustainable Taxonomy into public financial instruments, supporting the development of sustainable finance policies, and promoting ESG adoption in financial institutions. Key activities include producing the first Progress Report on the Sustainable Finance Mobilisation Strategy, developing biodiversity criteria with stakeholder input, and creating ESG tools aligned with international standards. With an estimated USD 750 billion needed by 2030, the project strengthens institutional capacity, promotes transparency, and helps redirect public and private capital toward sustainable projects, contributing to climate goals and financial system transformation. E2: The project supports Mexico in accelerating green finance mobilization and advancing its NDC commitments through three key areas: integrating the Sustainable Taxonomy into the federal budget and financial instruments; developing and monitoring sustainable finance policies; and strengthening ESG regulatory frameworks. Through close collaboration with SHCP, BANOBRAS, and NAFIN, the project enhances institutional capacity, promotes the issuance of Taxonomy-aligned bonds, supports transparent ESG reporting, and ensures inclusive and participatory policy development.
